question_or_proposition: For Aldrin at Outfall 001, does the effluent limits table row establish any enforceable numeric discharge limit, or does it impose only a report-only monitoring and reporting obligation with no applicable numeric compliance limit—and, given 'Report' appears in the 7-day average concentration column while measurement frequency is 1/Quarter grab sampling, what effluent statistic is the permittee obligated to report?
required_context: PART I Section A effluent limits table on page 4, including column headers and the Aldrin row
Permit authorization period covering Federal FY2025
notes: The nominated Aldrin row assigns N/A to all numeric limit columns and 'Report' to the 7-day average concentration column alongside quarterly grab monitoring.
